import openpyxl

def get_green_cells(path):
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path)
    ws = wb.active
    greens = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            fill = cell.fill
            if fill and fill.fgColor and getattr(fill.fgColor, 'type', None) == 'rgb':
                rgb = fill.fgColor.rgb
                if rgb in ['FF00FF00','FF008000','FF00FF99']:
                    greens.append((cell.row, cell.column))
    return greens
